criteria.title: Colour ramps
criteria.doneWhen: A ramp per hue used, neutral first, about 10 steps from lightest to darkest.

criteria.title: Background roles
criteria.doneWhen: Page, surface, raised, overlay and scrim.

criteria.title: Text roles
criteria.doneWhen: Primary, secondary, disabled, on-accent and link.

criteria.title: Border roles
criteria.doneWhen: Default, strong and focus.

criteria.title: Accent states
criteria.doneWhen: Default, hover and pressed.

platforms.mobile: Default and pressed; touch has no hover.

criteria.title: Status colours
criteria.doneWhen: Success, warning, danger and info, each with fill, text and border.

criteria.title: Theme parity
criteria.doneWhen: Every semantic colour role exists in each theme the product ships.

criteria.title: Type
criteria.doneWhen: Families with fallback stacks, a scale of 6 to 8 sizes, weights, line heights, and named roles (display, headings, body, label, caption, code).

platforms.mobile: The platform text styles the product uses (Dynamic Type or the Material type scale), with sizes, weights, line heights and named roles. A system font needs no fallback stack.
platforms.desktop: Families, a scale of 6 to 8 sizes, weights, line heights and named roles. A system font needs no fallback stack.

criteria.title: Spacing
criteria.doneWhen: A scale on one base unit (4 or 8 px).

criteria.title: Shape
criteria.doneWhen: Corner radii and border widths.

criteria.title: Sizing
criteria.doneWhen: Control heights per size, icon sizes, and the focus ring's width and offset.

platforms.mobile: Control heights, icon sizes, and touch targets (44 pt on iOS, 48 dp on Android).

criteria.title: Elevation
criteria.doneWhen: 3 to 5 shadow levels, each tied to a use (card, popover, dialog).

platforms.mobile: Shadows or materials (blur, glass) in 3 to 5 levels, each tied to a use.
platforms.desktop: Shadows or materials (vibrancy) in 3 to 5 levels, each tied to a use.

criteria.title: Motion
criteria.doneWhen: Durations, easing curves, and what changes under reduced motion.

criteria.title: Layout
criteria.doneWhen: Breakpoints, content widths, grid columns and z-index layers.

platforms.mobile: Screen margins, safe areas, the screen widths supported, and the layers sheets and modals sit on.
platforms.desktop: Window sizes, sidebar and inspector widths, and layers.

criteria.title: Contrast
criteria.doneWhen: Primary and secondary text pass WCAG AA (4.5:1) on page and surface backgrounds in every theme.

criteria.title: Provenance
criteria.doneWhen: Every token records where its value came from (measured, derived, sampled or reconstructed).

criteria.title: Component coverage
criteria.doneWhen: At least 17 of the 19 checklist components: button, icon button, link, text field, text area, select, checkbox, radio, switch, tabs, menu, tooltip, dialog, toast, card, list row, table, avatar, badge.

platforms.mobile: At least 17 of the 19 mobile checklist components: button, icon button, link, text field, text area, select or picker, checkbox or toggle, radio or segmented control, switch, tab bar, navigation bar, menu or action sheet, sheet, dialog or alert, toast or banner, card, list row, avatar, badge.
platforms.desktop: At least 17 of the 19 checklist components, plus toolbar, context menu and inspector when the product has them.

criteria.title: States
criteria.doneWhen: Components show states beyond default: hover, focus-visible, pressed, selected, disabled, loading, error, as each applies.

platforms.mobile: Components show states beyond default: pressed, selected, disabled, loading, error, as each applies (touch has no hover or focus-visible).

criteria.title: Focus
criteria.doneWhen: A visible focus state is captured for interactive components.

platforms.mobile: A visible focus state is captured for text inputs (and for keyboard focus where the platform shows it).

criteria.title: Token-based specs
criteria.doneWhen: Component entries are written in tokens, not raw values.

criteria.title: Behaviour
criteria.doneWhen: Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, and do and don't, per component.
criteria.optional: graded where the product publishes per-component guidance (keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, misuses), as a public design system does. A capture alone records what it saw, not the spec behind it.

criteria.title: Patterns
criteria.doneWhen: Written patterns: app shell, forms and validation, empty/loading/error, destructive confirmation, feedback, search and filtering, data display, onboarding.

criteria.title: Principles
criteria.doneWhen: 3 to 5 principles that decide real trade-offs, each with an example.
criteria.optional: graded where the product publishes its design principles. A capture alone sees the choices, not the reasons; the package's Do and don't list (K2) records the rules it can observe.

criteria.title: Voice
criteria.doneWhen: Tone, capitalisation, vocabulary and a formula for messages.
criteria.optional: graded where the product publishes a voice or content guide (tone, vocabulary, message formula). A capture alone holds the product's copy, not the guideline behind it.

criteria.title: Assets
criteria.doneWhen: Icon set indexed by role; fonts named with their licence or fallback.

platforms.mobile: Icons indexed by role, or the system icon set named (SF Symbols, Material Symbols); fonts named with their licence or fallback.
platforms.desktop: Icons indexed by role, or the system icon set named (SF Symbols, Material Symbols); fonts named with their licence or fallback.

criteria.title: Package entry
criteria.doneWhen: The README says what was captured, how, and what to distrust.

criteria.title: Do and don't
criteria.doneWhen: A style-wide list of rules the product follows that tokens cannot carry.

criteria.title: DESIGN.md
criteria.doneWhen: A generated DESIGN.md is present and current.
